notes.title: [Important] Saved Data Corruption of "Hanaby the Witch" (macOS Version Only)
notes.notes:
An issue was found in the macOS version that referred to the save data of the previous product "Hanaby the Witch". Ver. 1.0.3 has been updated to fix the issue.

Please update to Ver. 1.0.3 immediately if you play the macOS version.

The Windows version does not have this issue, but the version increases to Ver. 1.0.3.

[h3]1. For those who already have saved data of "Hanaby's Summer Festival" Ver. 1.0.2 or earlier[/h3]

Please copy the following file.
[list]
[*] Do not launch "Hanaby the Witch" until this operation is completed.
[*] Make a backup if it will be overwritten.
[/list]
From:
[u]/Library/Preferences/com.EnigmaticNetwork.Hanaby2.plist[/u]

To:
[u]/Library/Preferences/com.EnigmaticNetwork.Hanaby3.plist[/u]

By performing the above operations, saved data from Ver. 1.0.2 or earlier will be transferred to Ver. 1.0.3 or later.

If you have played "Hanaby the Witch" on the same PC, it is highly likely that the saved data has already been corrupted. I am very sorry, but the save data can't be recovered. I am very sorry that you have played a lot "Hanaby the Witch".

[h3]2. For those who have not yet played "Hanaby's Summer Festival" Ver. 1.0.2 or earlier[/h3]

Please be sure to play with Ver. 1.0.3 or later, which fixes the issue.

notes.title: Notification of ver.1.0.2 update
notes.notes:
Fixed an issue that the screen possibly stops in a blank state when a boss is defeated.

Note: we were not able to reproduce this issue, so we have fixed all the places where the issue possibly happens in theory.

notes.title: Notification of ver.1.0.1 update
notes.notes:
This version fixes some English errors.

Thanks to Lime Cultivist for reporting this issue!
